inspiration: Floating hit numbers coloured by event: damage yellow, HP loss red, HP gain green, mana blue and smaller, each with its own life span (lua/lib.3d.combat.lua lines 50-100). Keep the colour-by-event idea; change the palette and add a pop-in.

Upper-floor cutaway: anything above a head-height threshold is hidden when the player is inside (lua/lib.blendout.lua lines 6 and 11). Keep the automatic hide; change it to dissolving only the occluding piece.

Death as an explicit state, not a missing entity: the corpse module notes that health bars cannot tell death from leaving the screen (lua/lib.corpse.lua, comment block after line 11; not receipted). Relevant to row 17.

Fullscreen mood pass: NightVision and similar compositors draw one fullscreen quad after the scene (data/compositors/NightVision.compositor, line 2). Keep one state-driven pass; change the grade so it is not green night vision.

One signature particle per status: separate particle sets for mind, poison, wither, pain and strangle effects (data/particles/particles/, names only). Keep one set per status; change silhouettes and palette (rows 8 and 13).
Named sky families by mood: cleansky, darksun and sunset sets (data/skybox/textures/, names only). Keep named sets switched by zone mood; change the palette.

Layered text tables: a base string file plus an override file (lua/lib.cliloc.lua lines 26-40, CreateClilocLoader). Keep base plus override for our text tables; the strings themselves are not in the box.

briefs.label: Floating hit numbers by event type
briefs.why: a hit reads as a type before the number is read; short numbers stay legible at 375 wide
briefs.keep: colour by event type; size tier by magnitude; rise and fade over about two seconds
briefs.change: our own glyph style, a pop-in scale and our palette, not the yellow, red and green trio. Dom rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: Upper-floor cutaway for the fight camera
briefs.why: the player stays visible inside a building without changing the camera rig
briefs.keep: automatic hide of what sits above a head-height threshold; ground stays visible
briefs.change: dissolve only the occluding piece, dithered not hard-cut; our own threshold. Dom rule: a distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: State-driven mood pass
briefs.why: one switch changes the whole frame, so a state reads without a HUD label
briefs.keep: one fullscreen pass after the scene, driven by a single state value
briefs.change: our palette rather than green night vision; a timed pulse instead of a constant. Dom rule: a distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: One signature particle per status
briefs.why: a status reads as a shape during a fight, not as a text label
briefs.keep: one particle set per status; the motion carries the status
briefs.change: our own silhouettes and colours, no copied motif, one sound pair per status. Dom rule: a distinct original, never a copy
